content:
Okay so — a quick and kinda lazy refresher on how this stuff usually gets done bc I'm too tired to go into way too much detail

- 1. Download the most current source files (at time of writing, the [April upload here](https://discord.com/channels/1402537664619479100/1402537664619479103/1498160594136858814) is the most recent)
- 2. Find the lines you want to change, and make your changes, keeping note of which lines you changed.
- 3. Create a new spreadsheet file that contains __only__ the lines you changed, and __only__ the required columns;
  - The required columns are `Key`, `ShortKey`, `Source`, `Row`, `Module`, `Field`, `Role`, `CN`, and the target language.
  - Do __not__ change any values in any columns other than your language.
- 4. Save it specifically as **UTF-8 Comma-Separated Values** (.csv).
  - The name of the file should be formatted like this: `LANG`\_`Content`\_`Contribution Type`. This format is pretty loose so don't worry too much about it.
  - For example, if you did re-translation work on Sanga's Deepdive into Russian, it'd be RU\_SangaDeepdive\_Translation.csv, or if you proofread an existing translation for the flavor text on Wheels in English, it'd be EN\_WoDStory\_Proofreading.csv
  - DOUBLE CHECK that your computer's default settings are correct by opening your new file again and confirming that each column is separated by a comma `,` and NOT a semicolon `;` or anything else.
- 5. Go to the official [BIAV GitHub](https://github.com/BIAVGit/Morimens-Localizations/tree/main) and if you don't already have a fork of it, fork it (the button is in the top-right corner)
  - In your forked version of the BIAV repo, go to `/TRANSLATIONS/01_UPLOAD_YOUR_CONTRIBUTIONS` and into your language's folder. In there, upload your file.
  - Back in your forked repo's main page, click "Contribute" and open a Pull Request. Here, be sure to credit any other volunteers that worked on your uploaded file(s).
- 6. Once your pull request is submitted Ace will eventually collect/merge them and put the contribution in game.

Hopefully that's a good enough explanation lol
